title: Photo 145 · 애슬리트 USSBBW · 나전칠기 · 선 자세 정면 · 흑인 20대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless mid-grey backdrop, nothing else in the frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Black woman in her late 20s, deep near-black skin tone, THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, void complexion, not brown, not lightened, her face exactly as dark as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a high bun with a jewelled pin, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears large hoop earrings and has long glossy almond nails.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so wide that her hips are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. The body of a world's strongest woman pushed far past real limits: enormously broad thick shoulders, massive heavy arms so thick they cannot hang flat against her sides, a colossal bust, a huge barrel torso, no waist at all. On her middle. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, so much of it that it hangs far lower than it projects — sagging down over the tops of her thighs under its own weight rather than pushing forward, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other as it falls, each fold thicker than the one above it, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Colossal wide hips and a huge rounded powerful rear, tree-trunk thighs pressing together down to the knees, thick heavy calves. Immense power under a thick layer of soft fat: the muscle is huge but rounded and buried, only broad blunt swells at the shoulders, upper arms and thighs, no sharp muscle separation anywhere, no carved abs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her hands look small against her thighs. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is young and firm for its size, each fold holding a taut rounded shape. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how every part hangs, settles and presses against the part below it.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer covered with shimmering iridescent mother-of-pearl arabesque vines, peonies and cranes glowing pink, aqua and silver, wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense scrolls filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Standing square to the camera, full frontal, feet planted far apart, the heavy mass of her middle resting down on her thighs, arms held clear of her body with a visible gap of background between each arm and her side so her whole outline reads unbroken, full body head to toe.

Footwear: Extreme iridescent pearl-white platform stiletto mules, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the mother-of-pearl shimmering with rainbow iridescence, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
